title: Landsat 4 observation of Tasman Glacier in 1990

altText: Landsat 4 observation of Tasman Glacier in 1990 captured by Landsat 4 Thematic Mapper
caption: Landsat 4's Thematic Mapper recorded the Tasman Glacier and neighbouring valleys on 30 December 1990. This provides a period satellite observation rather than a modern reconstruction.
context: Primary dated Earth observation and satellite data product. The actual source image is preserved locally for this historical comparison.
